Diagram of the electrical method for determining specific heat capacity of a liquid. An insulated calorimeter containing a liquid. Inside the liquid is an electrical immersion heater connected to a DC power supply, a switch, an ammeter in series, and a voltmeter in parallel. A thermometer and a stirrer are also in the liquid.
Diagram of the method of mixtures apparatus. A well-insulated copper calorimeter containing water and a thermometer, with a hot metal block being dropped into it from a thread.
